description: This file contains helper functions and data structures used for managing wizard steps and options within a user interface workflow. It defines a `WizardOption` struct, functions to decode and parse wizard steps, and utility functions to interpret `AnyCodable` values as strings, booleans, arrays, and for comparisons.

classes.name: WizardOption
classes.description: Represents an option in a wizard interface, with an associated value, label, and optional hint.

methods.name: decodeWizardStep
methods.description: Decodes a raw dictionary into a WizardStep object using JSON encoding and decoding.

methods.name: parseWizardOptions
methods.description: Parses an array of dictionaries into an array of WizardOption objects.

methods.name: wizardStatusString
methods.description: Converts an AnyCodable value into a trimmed, lowercased string if possible.

methods.name: wizardStepType
methods.description: Retrieves the type string from a WizardStep object.

methods.name: anyCodableString
methods.description: Extracts a string representation from an AnyCodable value.

methods.name: anyCodableBool
methods.description: Interprets an AnyCodable value as a boolean.

methods.name: anyCodableArray
methods.description: Converts an AnyCodable value into an array of AnyCodable.

methods.name: anyCodableEqual
methods.description: Performs equality comparison between two AnyCodable values.
